Subject: Intro + request to schedule hands-on POC kickoff

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ClearSky wants to move into a short hands-on POC next week to validate routing behavior and run a small load test against a staging endpoint.

High-level asks from our side:
- 90-minute kickoff session with Redwood engineers (prompt review + routing overview)
- a separate 60-minute hands-on lab where our infra team runs a 1-hour load test (approx. 500 concurrent requests)
- preflight checklist for API keys, VPC allowlist, and sandbox accounts

Our preferred window: Tue/Wed afternoon PST next week. If you can share a checklist and confirmation of expected throttles/limits that would be great.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Product Manager, Integrations
ClearSky Logistics

Hi Sarah — great to hear. We can run both sessions; suggested plan below and a few questions.

Suggested schedule (tentative):
- Tue, Mar 30, 2027 13:00-14:30 PST: POC kickoff (prompt walkthrough, routing policy overview, KV/prefix caching notes)
- Wed, Mar 31, 2027 10:00-11:00 PST: Hands-on lab + load test (we'll coordinate limits and monitoring)

Questions:
1) Will your infra team be able to update a VPC allowlist and open outbound to 52.23.14.0/24 (staging)? If not, please tell us the procedure and lead.
2) Do you want us to provide temporary staging API keys scoped to the sandbox?
3) Any compliance constraints we should know about for logs or token retention?

I attached a short runbook and an allowlist template — Marissa (solutions eng) will lead the kickoff. Ben will run the hands-on lab.

If Tue/Wed works, I'll send calendar invites and a short preflight checklist.

Best,
vivek_kulkarni

Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah — quick intro from the engineering side. Short notes on what we'll cover in the kickoff and what we'd like you to prepare: 

Kickoff (90m) agenda:
- 15m: introductions + success criteria (confirm the flows you want to validate)
- 30m: prompt engineering and output stability checks (we'll bring sample prompt set)
- 20m: routing policies & fallbacks (region/cost/latency routing)
- 25m: environment runbook & Q/A (API keys, staging endpoints, allowlists)

Prep items for ClearSky: 
- Confirm a single point of contact for infra (email in the thread is fine).
- Populate the allowlist-template.csv with the IPs your proxy will use.
- Create a staging service account for us to mint scoped API keys, or tell us the rotation process if you handle keys.

I'll drop the sample prompt set in the Drive link Vivek included. Priyom will post the exact rate-limits and an ops checklist in a follow-up.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearskylogistics.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: ClearSky POC — preflight ops checklist & limits

Hey all — sharing the preflight checklist and expected throughput envelope so ClearSky can confirm readiness.

Preflight checklist (actionable items):
- API keys: We will provide two staging keys: one with full read/write for the lab, one scoped to token-only usage for monitoring. If you prefer to issue keys from your side, send the key rotation instructions.
- VPC allowlist: Add the following CIDRs to your outbound allowlist for the session window: 52.23.14.0/24, 34.201.67.0/24. (Template attached: vpc-allowlist-template.csv)
- Sandbox accounts: Create a ClearSky-staging account with a service-role that can call the /v1/infer endpoint.
- Endpoints: Use https://staging.redwood-infer.com/clearsky for the POC.
- Metrics: We'll expose Prometheus scrape endpoints and a temporary Grafana dashboard link during the test.
- Rate limits for load test: We recommend a stepped ramp to 500 rps sustained for 10 minutes, then peak to 750 rps for 2 minutes. We'll throttle to keep latency SLOs.

Attachments referenced: poc-runbook-v2.pdf, vpc-allowlist-template.csv

If ClearSky's infra has maintenance windows or IP egress restrictions, please flag them now so we can route accordingly.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearskylogistics.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@clearskylogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearSky POC — preflight ops checklist & limits

Thanks — checklist looks good. A couple of notes from infra:
- We cannot allow 34.201.67.0/24 outbound from our prod proxies; we'll instead open 52.23.14.0/24 and a narrower range 52.23.14.128/26 for the immediate window.
- We'll issue staging keys from our side; rotation is through our internal vault and they expire after 48 hours.
- Can Redwood confirm the exact TLS SNI hostname and any required client certs?

Also, can we shift the kickoff one day later? Tue/Wed next week conflicts with a vendor audit. Proposed new windows: Wed Mar 31, 14:00-15:30 PST (kickoff) and Thu Apr 1, 10:00-11:00 PST (hands-on + load test).

Sarah
